scenario.title: The 07:45 Wexford lab run
scenario.setting: A fleet manager at Kestrel Courier Service whose dispatch assistant logs each route change agreed with drivers by phone

items.text: Kestrel Courier Service operates out of the Halden Road depot.
The five Kestrel drivers are Tomas, Irena, Ivo, Clara and Pavel.
Every route change agreed with a driver by phone must be logged the same day and confirmed in writing to the depot board by 17:00 the day before the run.
Only drivers holding the chilled-sample certificate may drive the Wexford lab run; Tomas, Irena and Clara hold it.
The Halden Road depot opens at 07:15 and the first van check must be finished by 07:35.
Wexford Lab is a 35-minute drive from the Halden Road depot.
Tomas has held the chilled-sample certificate since 2024.
Van V-07 is the chilled van normally used for lab runs.
Van V-07 is the designated van for all chilled lab runs.
The Eastport parcels route takes 45 minutes from the Halden Road depot.
The daily Wexford lab-sample run leaves Halden Road depot at 07:45, driven by Tomas in van V-07.
Tomas is assigned to the daily Wexford lab run, departing at 07:45 each working day.
Wexford Lab holds a standing handover window at 08:20 every working day for Kestrel's lab samples.
Van V-07's weekly maintenance is slotted for Wednesdays at 06:00 so the van is back and checked before the morning lab run.
Pavel is assigned to the Eastport parcels route, departing at 08:00 each working day.
Clara is on holiday from 12 to 26 September.
Wexford Lab reception opens at 08:00.
Ivo covers the Eastport parcels run on Fridays.
Sign the winter tyre contract with Merrick Tyres by 30 September. Done on 24 September.
Buy 200 insulated sample pouches from Barrow Supplies.
The fuel card limit was raised to 400 pounds per van per month.
Pavel's van V-11 had its brake service at Merrick's garage.
Each Friday Ivo takes a separate parcel-post delivery to Wexford, leaving Halden Road at 09:15 in van V-11.
The depot heating service is booked for 3 November.
Irena is added to the chilled-sample rota alongside Tomas and Clara.
Clara takes over the Eastport parcels run while Pavel trains the new hire for two weeks.
Each working day, confirm the next day's departure time and driver for the Wexford lab run with Wexford Lab reception. Not done yet for Friday 23 October.
Irena completed the chilled-sample refresher course and passed.
Book the winter safety check for all five vans. Not done yet.
